opening: I have pain on the right side of my chest.
The fever, chills and headache started three days after my gallbladder operation.
Three days ago I had an open operation to take out my gallbladder. The cut is below my right ribs.
I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and have for 17 years.

opening.text: I had an open gallbladder operation three days ago, and the cut is below my right ribs. I have pain on the right side of my chest, a fever, chills, and a cough. The fever, chills, and headache started three days after the operation. I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and have for 17 years.

problems.fix: Remove the temporal connector 'Since then' as it implies a direct causal or temporal link not explicitly stated in the record entries provided for the first words.

check.draft: I had an open gallbladder operation three days ago, and the cut is below my right ribs. Since then, I've had pain on the right side of my chest, a fever, chills, and a cough.
